answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 33056 Country: United Kingdom Title: What is the Fiqh when water becomes najis (impure) and its conditions? Question: What is the Fiqh when water becomes najis (impure) and its conditions? Answer ID: 33056 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1365/825/D=1432) When water gets impure, it is not lawful to use it to clean any thing like clothes, body and other things, rather if the impure water gets to clothes or on any part of the body it shall make it impure. Your question is not very clear, so if you are not satisfied, submit the question again in clear-cut words. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
